title: Sheet profile
description: One client's drawing conventions: how their drawing numbers, revisions, titles and scales are written, and how their drawing list is laid out.

id.description: File-name-safe identifier. Must match the file name.

label.description: Name shown in the Setup screen dropdown. Sentence case.

number_patterns.description: Regular expressions matching a drawing number, most specific first.

number_labels.description: Lower-case title block labels that sit next to the drawing number.

revision_patterns.description: Regular expressions matching a revision code. Capture group 1 is the code.

revision_scheme.description: The client's revision scheme, when known in advance.

list_column_mapping.description: Remembered column mapping for this client's drawing list, so the user confirms it once rather than every time.
